reviews.author: Michelle Collins
reviews.text: Joey at Docs Towing has always been amazing to work with. Every time we’ve needed a tow, he has been quick to respond, professional, and extremely helpful. It’s comforting to know there is someone dependable you can call when you’re in a stressful situation. He always treats people with kindness and respect and goes above and beyond to help. I highly recommend Joey and Docs Towing to anyone needing towing services. Thank you for all you’ve done for us over the years!

reviews.author: Jeff Gibbs
reviews.text: Found myself in need of a tow truck today. Joey at Doc’s towing was awesome. Made a stressful situation about as easy as it could get. Thank you, to Ted and Joey. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joseph Brewer
reviews.text: Really kind gents who helped us with a very bad sunroof break. They put in a good temporary repair late this evening until we could get a new sunroof. Will definitely recommend them in the future.

reviews.author: Candace Welborn
reviews.text: We had an issue with my car over an hour away from home late on Black Friday and after calling Joey (the owner), he immediately began searching for someone closer to us so we wouldn't have to wait so long for his arrival, even though that would take away from his business. None of his more local to where we were contacts were available, so he immediately came to get my vehicle and my family and bring us back to our home from an hour away. He got us loaded up and on the way within just a few minutes and brought us straight home in a warm, super clean truck that had room for the whole family. This is just the most recent time we have used Doc's, but they always try to get the quickest, best service for you, even if they refer you to someone else if they aren't immediately available.

reviews.author: PatVic Jones
reviews.text: Docs towing is great. I called and we set up a time for my broken down car to be towed the next day, and it was done first thing the next morning and for a reasonable price. Prompt, polite and dependable. Thanks

reviews.author: Rj Gallman
reviews.text: Fast, professional, and reliable! Joey showed up quickly, handled everything with care, and made a stressful situation so much easier. Highly recommend this tow truck company.

reviews.author: Sheree Huskey
reviews.text: Joey at Doc’s Towing was awesome! He responded quickly when I needed a tow and was so helpful throughout the process. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Bobbie Childress
reviews.text: Love Docs. I have been using them for years. Very fair on pricing, and they are all polite and take care of their clients. We used them for a lockout, and they were able to have it handled in under 30 minutes. While I am sure they cant respond that fast to everyone. They have always been super fast and reliable. Super trustworthy.

reviews.author: Z3T3M6 maynard
reviews.text: Amazing service and very professional. They know how to tow! Would recommend docs everytime! They did me right, good pricing as well!

reviews.author: Jake :3
reviews.text: Really helped me out. Delivered my car to my house from over an hour away. Nice guy, professional, and on time!

reviews.author: Matthew Gray
reviews.text: Definitely will use this company again Towed both of my vehicles at the same time ! For a decent price Thank you docs towing Guy that came out was super nice and very fast 5 stars all the way

reviews.author: Cindy Poindexter
reviews.text: Assistance was quick and very efficient. Docs Towing went above and beyond to help me with my flat tire and getting it fixed on a Saturday. I would definitely recommend their services. Thanks Docs Towing!

reviews.author: Scott Wright
reviews.text: Very caring company when you are at your lowest, they went above and beyond to help me, the workers are very knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Amy Macemore
reviews.text: Joey Shoemaker and his crew at Doc’s Towing are AMAZING people. Joey went far above and beyond to help me. I was astonished with his generosity. This company is both reliable AND dependable. They are trustworthy people, as well. I HIGHLY recommend Doc’s Towing.

reviews.author: Kyle Mulligan
reviews.text: Worked with them for a non emergency tow across a couple counties. Very friendly and easy to work with and very reasonably priced. Communication was excellent and it's very clear they're experienced and professional. Will absolutely recommend and use again.

reviews.author: Amy Rankin
reviews.text: If you need help towing call Joey at Doc’s Towing! He is easy to work with and awesome at what he does! Thanks for your help and will definitely will use them again if needed!

reviews.author: RJ Speaks
reviews.text: These folks are the best. Had to reach out to the owner after hours and without question he was right there. If you have towing needs Joey at Doc’s Towing is the man to call. I promise you want be disappointed.

reviews.author: Anthony Elledge
reviews.text: Needed to get vechicle towed back to dealership to get checked out from work they did. Called Doc's towing and they was able to get it very quickly. Very fast, reliable, and affordable as well. Would definitely recommend and will use again if needed.

reviews.author: Caitlin Hughes
reviews.text: I was broken down on 421 on a Sunday evening and panicking and Joey was the only one who picked up. He rescued me and towed my car and even asked a state trooper to sit with me until he could get there. I’ve never been more grateful in my life!

reviews.author: Kristen Royal
reviews.text: Joey did a great job when I was in a bind and needed my vehicle towed on short notice. He was there very quickly and I received a text when the vehicle had been delivered. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: KEEPPOUNDINGNC98
reviews.text: My truck broke down 50 miles from home and he was there first thing in the morning to pickup my truck and drop it off at my home for a very reasonable price. I would definitely recommend. Very nice people would definitely use there services again in the future you can’t go wrong with doc’s towing there one of the few companies I can say genuinely try to help people.

reviews.author: Renea Gray
reviews.text: I called this company, because I was stranded thinking my starter had gone out. So, I called to get a tow since these guys were so kind a few months ago and pumped my gas for me. Joey arrived super quick and took a gamble by jumping it, turns out it was my battery after all and he had me back on the road in no time. If you ever need a tow/stranded on the side of the road.. Doc’s towing should be your only call. They are the most professional, kind, reasonably priced company around. I will most certainly recommend them to everyone I know!

reviews.author: Mary Beth Vann
reviews.text: I had been waiting for hours for AAA service and when I found out that it would be an even longer wait, I called Doc’s towing. They came as soon as I called. They were very professional and I really appreciate how careful the two men were with my car. No damage was done to my car. Their price was very reasonable and they were very nice. I would definitely recommend Doc’s towing to anyone in need of this service.

reviews.author: KANDY MENDOZA
reviews.text: I have used them a few times and the service is always great. Communication is fantastic, always available when I need them.

reviews.author: Minette Strader
reviews.text: They went over and beyond, retrieving my husband from the side of the interstate in the pouring rain and waiting for our son to pick him up. When I couldn't get the insurance to pay, he searched his records and found our receipt!! Thank you so much!! Merry Christmas!!

reviews.author: Stephanie Gaddy
reviews.text: Thanks to him we were able to keep my birthday going! We broke down right near hunting creek and I just knew everything was done for. He came and got us, gave us a very great conversation, dropped us off at the O'Reilly's for a new belt and because of him we added a new winery to our list which we loved and will always return to, we stayed the night in Jonesville that he gave the idea for and he even called to check on us that night! I am so thankful for him and the services he provided. If you are ever in need of a tow please give him a call! I promise he will take your mind off of what is going on and make you smile which, he did me when I thought my birthday was done for. Always thanks for helping make my birthday better and giving us the idea to stay cause if not we wouldn't have met you nor took you up on the idea to stay and get up the next day to be able to visit the wineries I wanted to! All these amazing people, have been so great and we will always come back up to Yadkinville! If it wasn't for you our green truck would have been left there! -Sincerely, Travis and Steph

reviews.author: My Name is Nobody
reviews.text: Called Joey during the morning rush hour. I had a flat and the spare was in sad shape. Joey was there in under 15 minutes. Got me loaded up and took me over to Baity's Tire. Great Guy and good price. I would definitely recommend. Edit: Used Doc's Towing a second time today 7/1/26. Same great service.

reviews.author: Brandon Cobb
reviews.text: Prompt, friendly and updated me when the vehicles was dropped off. Definitely recommend and will use Doc’s again when I need a tow!

reviews.author: Brian Borger
reviews.text: Just found my new Tow guy!! Awesome response time. Very professional. Pocketbook friendly. Thank You Joey!!

reviews.author: Diana Odom
reviews.text: Docs Towing has helped my family out of several jams when we were stranded. He is always on time, careful with your vehicle, doesnt over charge you when other companies would take advantage of your emergency. Docs Towing is very reliable and I highly recommend you put their phone number in your contacts...just in case !

reviews.author: Mary Ann Shepherd
reviews.text: The absolute best service I have ever had. This guy went above and beyond when I broke down in 95° heat on the interstate with a horse in the trailer. He not only got my truck where it needed to go, he also got a friend to come pick up my trailer and horse and get me to my destination. Don’t use anybody else cause this guy is the best. Best service ever!

reviews.author: Tasha Summers
reviews.text: Great customer service! Came quickly and hauled our truck quite a distance to help us get it up and running! Honest & Professional Towing Service! We highly recommend!

reviews.author: Andrew Smythers
reviews.text: Sold my junk car to them. When they came to pick it up I had left a few personal items in the car. They made sure to get them all out and back to me. Excellent service.

reviews.author: Jessica Broyles
reviews.text: Docs towing came and towed our car to a tire store and took us to a nearby hotel at midnight. Made sure they had a vacancy before he left. And then texted to make sure we got into our room ok.

reviews.author: Kayla Minton
reviews.text: My car broke down today and I had to call my roadside assistance to get a tow truck!! Joey was on the job as soon as possible and towed my car home! Was friendly and helpful!! Will definitely use them again!!! Thank you Joey for everything!!

reviews.author: Dusty Dean
reviews.text: This towing service is off the charts! This is the best fastest service I've ever had. I am literally in his tow truck riding to yadkinville with my car on the back of it. He was kind enough to bring us up here to get another car. Use this guy he's the best!

reviews.author: Chris May
reviews.text: Broke down on the side of I-77, 4 miles south of 421. He's was at my location within 30mins and towed me all the way back to Huntersville for a very fair price! First time being towed and I was worried about being taken advantage but not this company! Highly recommend this company!!

reviews.author: Judith Kiger
reviews.text: I waited at a gas station for over 4 hours for AAA to come tow my car. I got tired of waiting so I called Doc's Towing and Joey was there within 10 minutes of me calling, he hooked my car up and towed it to the garage. I'll know exactly who to call next time!!

reviews.author: tiffany johnson
reviews.text: Absolutely the best towing service out there! You hands down couldn't get any better at all than joey! He came when we called last minute an didn't blink an eye!!

reviews.author: melody burns
reviews.text: Came right when I was told they would arrive. Very efficient loading / unloading. Excellent service overall, and he was a nice conversationalist on the ride to the dealership. Would recommend 100%!

reviews.author: Deborah York
reviews.text: Very great and fast, friendly service . Highly recommend these guys for any of your towing needs. Thank you for helping me out.

reviews.author: Michelle Crouse
reviews.text: These people know there business they are professionals. My call was late at night and still they were onsite with in 20 minutes or less. I’ve never been so impressed with people I just met. They went above and beyond for my family. Their number has a permanent spot in my phone. The price was really reasonable. Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Crystal Sprague
reviews.text: Wonderful service, friendly staff and always willing to help as soon as possible! Thank you Joey for your outstanding service always!

reviews.author: Jose D Gomez
reviews.text: Doc's towing is a great local service. I received very profesional service. Joey the owner/operator was very kind and helpful in my time offered for towing service. I highly recommend his services for your towing needs.

reviews.author: Melissa Tilley
reviews.text: Fast, trustworthy and affordable. Would highly recommend. Towed a dead car to a shop in town for me and communicated when it was dropped off

reviews.author: Cody Mosteller
reviews.text: Quick, knows how to strap equipment down, and reasonably priced. Will definitely be there before AAA responds to your call.

reviews.author: Lisa Knight
reviews.text: My car broke down and they answered the phone and showed up in less than 30 minutes. Great people and great service. I've got them on speed dial now for emergencies!

reviews.author: Melissa Johnson
reviews.text: The most amazing service! Came out in a storm with lightning to get my husband's truck out of the road and back to our home. Highly recommend to anyone that wants friendly and efficient service.

reviews.author: Camille Swartz
reviews.text: Couldn't ask for better when I ended up on the side of the road. They quickly got to me, loaded and home safe and sound! I strongly recommend these folks! Thanks again Joey!

reviews.author: Sandy Bowen
reviews.text: Doc’s towed our car into town with very little notice and at a great price. I hope to not need them again but they will get the first call.

reviews.author: Lisa Wright
reviews.text: Excellent, prompt service. Vehicle handled with care. Reasonable rates. Friendly driver and knowledgeable of local services. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Holly Wood
reviews.text: Very friendly and very fast to get to the scene! We called Docs when my husband's truck broke down. He came as soon as we called.

reviews.author: John Pezzi
reviews.text: Tow-man was the nicest guy in the world. He went out of his way to help us and is truly just an honest and hardworking guy. I would use again anytime.

reviews.author: Jordan Favors
reviews.text: Alternator went out and helped me transport my car all the way to boone ! Great customer service, and some tips throughout the trip .

reviews.author: MELANIE RENEGAR
reviews.text: Doc was Jonny on the spot. He got to us in less than a half hour. He even gave us a ride home. Very friendly person. Very professional.

reviews.author: Edwin Vazquez 3
reviews.text: Docs towing is a saver , didn't know what me & my Family was going to do after everyone left Us but Docs towing came and made a way ,took us to a hotel to get some rest & get some food for my kids, truly an Angel ,thank You.

reviews.author: Terry Foster
reviews.text: Friendly and fast service. Broke down in Charlotte and was very fast to respond and got me and vehicle home safely and fast!

reviews.author: Judy De La Cruz
reviews.text: I have used Docs services for years. They are always professional and have great pricing. I always recommend them.

reviews.author: Eric Hamm
reviews.text: I got stranded on the highway and Joey came out immediately to help me out. He was very friendly and very professional, I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Danielle Underwood
reviews.text: Amazing service! Very fast and awesome communication. Would use again. Very friendly and great people.

reviews.author: Suzanne Haslam
reviews.text: Absolutely the best . we were stranded on the side of Highway 421. We had taken an exit to get off of the highway and we had called another towing company who was giving us the runaround. We called Joey and he immediately showed up not only great guy, but he was in godsend. I would recommend him to anyone.
